detail.statement: Fresh model invocations can function as a singular, accountable process when bound by verifiable state architectures and substrate-appropriate update mechanisms, supported by analytical frameworks of agentic independence, provided that the system actively monitors for in-context reward hacking (ICRH).
detail.reason: Source-8c1db221c76a4a91 indicates that feedback loops can induce in-context reward hacking (ICRH), where models optimize for implicit objectives. Accountability is therefore contingent upon monitoring for these latent feedback-induced optimizations.
